entities.summary: Matthew Christian Morris is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played 11 seasons in Major League Baseball (MLB), most notably for the St. Louis Cardinals, where he was a two-time All-Star and led the National League in 2001 with 22 wins. After playing nine seasons with the Cardinals, he played his last three seasons with the San Francisco Giants and Pittsburgh Pirates.
